title: Frog Angel and Cosmic Egg
description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts a large glowing green frog with angel wings and a halo floating in the dark sky, overlooking a cracked white egg structure embedded with a giant purple eye, gears, and miniature buildings. In the foreground, three ghostly hooded figures stand near a broken fence and gravestones while a stone path leads toward a distant hilltop castle beneath a red sun.
